headline: Plantation Stocks First Resources and Bumitama Agri Drop on Haze Notices
summary: Shares in First Resources and Bumitama Agri fell after Singapore's National Environment Agency issued notices regarding regional environmental haze.
why: Palm oil producers operating in Southeast Asia face regulatory scrutinies and potential compliance liabilities related to environmental emissions and transboundary haze.

impacts.name: First Resources
impacts.why: Receipt of environmental haze notices raised regulatory risk concerns among investors.

impacts.name: Bumitama Agri
impacts.why: Involvement in haze regulatory checks negatively impacted investor sentiment.

why_moved: Share prices dropped after the Singapore environment agency issued regulatory notices regarding environmental haze to the plantation companies.
